title: Determination of glyphosate and aminomethylphosphonic acid residues in Finnish soils
author: Sari, Juho, et al.

steps.title: Weigh soil replicates
steps.instruction: Weigh three replicates of each soil sample, each weighing 3.0 g ± 0.5 g, into separate extraction vessels.

steps.title: Add recovery and internal standards
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL of GLUF recovery standard (0.5 µg) to research samples only; then add 50 µL of each WSIS1 and WSIS2 (0.5 µg total) to all samples (research and matrix‑matched calibration) before adding extraction solvent.

steps.title: Extract with KOH solution
steps.instruction: Add 25 mL of 0.6 M KOH to each sample and perform two successive extractions.

substeps.instruction: Shake horizontally for 15 min at 220 min⁻¹.
Centrifuge at 3500 × g for 15 min and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Combine and neutralise extracts
steps.instruction: Take a 5 mL aliquot from each of the two 25 mL extracts, combine them, mix well, and neutralise the combined extract with 6 M and 0.6 M HCl to reach pH 8 ± 0.5.

steps.title: Final centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the neutralised mixture at 3500 × g for 10 min and discard the sediment, retaining the clear extract for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare calibration series
steps.instruction: Prepare multipoint matrix‑matched calibration samples ranging from the lowest to the highest concentration levels.

steps.title: Run calibration and blanks
steps.instruction: Inject the calibration series in order, followed by a solvent injection before the first real sample to avoid carry‑over; repeat the entire calibration series at the end of the sample list.

steps.title: Inject control standard
steps.instruction: After every nine sample injections, inject a 20 ng mL⁻¹ GLUF control standard, then inject a solvent blank.
